name: wellness-gym-mobile
description: Application mobile Android / iPhone du personnel de la salle de sport WELLNESS HOTEL (Capacitor).

scripts.android:init: npm run preparer && npx cap add android && node scripts/adapter-android.js && npx capacitor-assets generate --android
scripts.android:sync: npm run preparer && npx cap sync android && node scripts/adapter-android.js
scripts.ios:init: npm run preparer && npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios && bash scripts/adapter-ios.sh
scripts.ios:sync: npm run preparer && npx cap sync ios && bash scripts/adapter-ios.sh
